Name: BiggerHoppers
Author: eelnomad
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bigger Hoppers expands hoppers from 36 to 70 item slots to match the capacity of a vanilla Big Chest.

It's built to pair with Filtered Chest Hopper. When you use hoppers to auto-sort items into chests by category, a hopper can only hold as many items as it has slots. The vanilla 36 often isn't enough to cover a full category and can be awkward feeding into a 70-slot Big Chest. Bigger Hoppers raises the ceiling to 70 so a filtered hopper can move a whole category at once and make full use of the larger chests.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install this mod one of two ways:
  - With Vortex: click the download button for Vortex.
  - Manually: download the zip, then unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
2. Unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI (https://smapi.io) 4.0+ (required)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Recommended[/b]
- Filtered Chest Hopper (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21730) — the intended companion mod; not required, but it's the reason this exists
- Generic Mod Config Menu (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) — optional, for the in-game capacity toggle

Multiplayer note: every player needs this mod installed, since capacity is calculated on each player's game. Before uninstalling, empty any hopper holding more than 36 items — the extras aren't deleted, but they'll be hidden until the mod is reinstalled.[/color]
